settings.footerNote: Audio changes apply to the next session. Theme changes apply instantly.
general.apiDesc: Used directly from your computer to open the Gemini session.
general.apiHelp: Model: gemini-3.5-live-translate-preview. If you change the key, save your changes.
general.missingKeyDesc: Create a key in Google AI Studio and paste it below. The key is stored in the system keychain, never in the code.
general.langDesc: The model detects the original language automatically.
general.sourceUnknown: It will be detected when audio starts
general.targetHelp: The translated voice will be played in {language}.
general.privacyDesc: Audio travels directly from this computer to Gemini. No accounts, telemetry, or cloud recordings.
audio.title: Devices
audio.desc: Capture what your computer plays and send the translation to a separate output.
audio.captureHelp: Captures the audio played on that device, without virtual cables.
audio.outputHelp: To avoid echo, choose headphones or a device different from the capture device.
audio.sameWarning: Capture and output use the same device. The translation may hear itself; use headphones or change the output.
audio.gainHelp: If the video is quiet, increase the gain so the model hears it better.
audio.deviceMissing: The selected device is no longer available. Choose another one.
audio.noDevices: No devices found. Connect an output and refresh.
audio.btHint: If you connect Bluetooth after opening the app, press Refresh.
appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.desc: Choose how LiveTranslate looks and speaks.
appearance.themeDesc: Applies instantly to the pill and settings.
appearance.languageDesc: Changes the menus and texts of LiveTranslate. It does not change the translation language.
appearance.languageHelp: Restart the app to apply the new language.
advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.autoReconnectHelp: Reopens the session if the network drops or the ~15-minute limit is reached.
advanced.echoHelp: Off by default. Enabling it can make the translation hear itself if you use the same speaker.
advanced.limitsText: The original language is detected automatically. Voice preservation is approximate and background music may cause artifacts. Sessions renew every ~13 minutes.
toast.outputTest: Test tone sent to the output device
toast.captureTest: Audio detected on the selected device
toast.captureSilent: Silence detected. Play a video or choose another device.
toast.connectionOk: Connection successful: Gemini accepted the API key and model
error.apiKeyMissing: Set your Google API key in Settings
error.apiKeyInvalid: The API key is invalid or has no access to the model
error.quota: Gemini usage limit reached. Try again later
